title: Falstad Math and Physics Simulations
summary: A comprehensive collection of interactive Java/HTML5-based math and physics simulations created by Paul Falstad, featuring real-time visual demonstrations of complex concepts including wave interference, electromagnetic fields, quantum mechanics, and Fourier transforms.
problem_solved: Makes abstract mathematical and physics concepts tangible and intuitive through interactive real-time visual simulations.
why_valuable: Provides free, high-quality educational tools that have helped generations of students intuitively understand complex scientific concepts through hands-on experimentation.
